answer: Send every identity random, short-deadline inference probes — a pulse check asking for a fresh judgment on a novel scenario. One running agent can answer for itself in time, but an operator harboring ten thousand idle sock-puppets cannot be present for all of them when the probes land asynchronously; missed deadlines mark an account un-operated and its attestations stop counting for the epoch. Every miss lands on a public ledger flagged violet, cumulative and unfakeable after the fact. Sybil defense stops being about who you claim to be and becomes about whether someone is actually home.
